value.rationale: The source raises classification of semigroup Schur partitions as a new research direction and treats automorphic partitions as a natural class. This theorem fully classifies two-block partitions in an infinite two-parameter family, locates the sharp first failure of automorphicity at 24 elements, and counts both sides of that boundary exactly (540 nonautomorphic of 968). This structural boundary is not merely a routine parameter increment or an arbitrary isolated computation.
